title: A bench or test must not run activation cleanup on the OS activator
rule: When a bench, tool or test builds the app's services over a scratch home (CoreApi, ActivationManager) and runs session start or shutdown (clear_session, start, shutdown), give it a MockActivator or a scratch-keyed activator, never fm_platform::activator::system. The OS activator keeps its records per user, not per home (the Windows ledger is one HKCU key), so a cleanup there deregisters the session fonts of the user's running app. Test it by seeding a session registration in the activator the code is given and asserting the cleanup reached that one.
rationale: E5.11 (#285): fm-bench start ran CoreApi::start on the system activator; on Windows that cleared the real per-user session ledger, including fonts a running Font Manager had activated.
